subject: Render HTTPS connection refused to api.ipapi.is - CYBERORBIT
text:
Hello ipapi.is Support,

Please help investigate HTTPS connectivity from our Render-hosted CYBERORBIT backend to api.ipapi.is on TCP port 443.

The Render service's outbound IP ranges are:
74.220.52.0/24
74.220.60.0/24

Both the standard HTTPS request and an explicit IPv4 HTTPS retry fail with ECONNREFUSED before receiving an HTTP response from your API. One recorded failure occurred on 2026-10-20 at 10:57:23 UTC.

Redacted production diagnostics:
[endpoint-city-transport] {"action":"retry-ipv4","provider":"api.ipapi.is","networkCodes":["ECONNREFUSED"]}
[endpoint-city-provider] {"provider":"ipapi.is","status":"lookup-unavailable","reason":"connection-refused","networkCodes":["ECONNREFUSED"]}

The same configured provider/key combination succeeded from our local development network using a public test IP. Our endpoint heartbeat and telemetry APIs remain healthy.

Could you check endpoint health and any access/firewall restrictions affecting these Render outbound ranges? If access requires approval or a configuration change, please advise the supported procedure. We have not established whether the refusal is provider-side or along the hosting network path.

No API credentials or employee IP addresses are included in this request.

Thank you,
CYBERORBIT deployment team
